responses.change: An observation seq is allocated and persisted under the lock before each fetch, and import is ordered by seq, not completion time. Request context (purpose, requested version) is stored separately from observed facts (head, base, merge_base, bindings, checks). A newer-seq observation updates facts and invalidates gates and Pass even if requested under an older version; an older superseded observation is history only and cannot restore the old version. Out-of-order completion and new-head cases are added. This is a counter update only; no read-operation lifecycle.

An explicit G2 verdict rule is added. Assignment and result bind the full PR diff (base…head), applicable spec/design/AC digests and prior findings. G2 passes only for an authorized independent reviewer with full scope, current version, verdict clean and no unresolved blocking. changes_required means failed; blocked means unknown with no round opened; a missing, malformed or partial review cannot pass. This does not weaken AC-G11.

Task 8.0 adds a skill/human D27 handoff: the B1 PR must be human-accepted, the actual merge confirmed through a GitHub read with the merge commit recorded, and the baseline registered via `register binding --role baseline`. There is no automatic merge, and T8 does not start otherwise. The pre-B1 real run (4.2) is redefined as an isolated fixture probe on branch probe/s1-g1: not the delivery feature, never merged.

Safe stopping is now separated from demo completion. Evidence-backed Blocked is a valid safe stop but does not complete R3 or 8.1. Completion requires a real finding→fix→re-review, three gates passing on the current version, and a successful resume after interruption. Without a genuine finding the coverage stays open, and no finding is manufactured.

The replay sentence that the baseline (review-09/spec-delta.md:110) added to AC-G06 THEN is expressly deleted. AC-G06 now states that the normal path needs no replay, and that replay runs only on contradiction or risk as a diagnostic and cannot fabricate an original Red. Original Red, scope/lineage, current Green and regression remain required. A normal valid Red without replay and a contradiction case with diagnostic replay are added.

One execution table is added covering every task: owned paths, public interface, dependencies and an exact verification command. Task 1.1 owns creation of the CI workflow. Placeholder `tests/<file>` entries are replaced with exact files. W1 is completed with base B, the destination path, preserving the existing loop-engineering-thin README.md and docs/ into loop-engineering-thin.pre-w1 with sha256 lists before `git worktree add`, and restoring the candidate docs to docs/design-candidate with digest comparison. These steps are described only, not executed.
